name: structural-stream-dispatch
body: The scan-driver and ingestor wiring that makes the structural streams first-class: the driver lists the structural language ids, resolves the `structfrontend` command, and spawns it under the existing per-stream `lang_switch` contract (`rust.apg.available_languages`, `rust.apg.frontend_cmd`, `rust.apg.spawn_frontend`); the ingestor roots each structural module under its stream id and renders its `Struct` records' FQNs (`rust.apg.ingest.ingest_records`, `rust.apg.ingest.root_module_fqn`) and classifies its records (`rust.apg.classify.builtin_code_type`).
